title: Utopia Parkway
author: Elliot Sperber
content:
![](https://www.counterpunch.org/wp-
content/uploads/2026/05/utopiaparkway.jpeg)

Utopia Parkway  
in Queens  
Five miles of traffic  
and injury  
The booming, fuming  
Irony

The fruit of a world war  
economy  
Damaging so many  
Who continue to say:  
It’s the only way  
it can’t but be  
The tao of death  
and lunacy
